checks.text: The page shows the heading "Changelog Generator" and the text "No commits yet".
Typing "feat: add login" in the field labelled "Commit message" and clicking the button "Add commit" adds a list item containing "feat: add login"; the text "No commits yet" is gone.
After adding "fix: null pointer" and "docs: update readme", the list shows three items in the order "feat: add login", "fix: null pointer", "docs: update readme".
Clicking the button "Delete fix: null pointer" removes that item; the list now shows only "feat: add login" and "docs: update readme".

Clicking the button "Generate changelog" with commits "feat: add login" and "docs: update readme" shows a Markdown preview containing the heading "## Features" with the item "add login" and the heading "## Documentation" with the item "update readme".
In the Markdown preview, clicking the checkbox next to "add login" toggles it to checked; the rendered HTML contains `<input type="checkbox" checked>`.

Clicking the button "Copy Markdown" copies the exact text "## Features
- [ ] add login

## Documentation
- [ ] update readme" to the clipboard.

Clicking the button "Export" opens a menu; clicking "JSON" downloads a file named "changelog.json" containing the JSON array `[{"message":"feat: add login","section":"Features"},{"message":"docs: update readme","section":"Documentation"}]`.
Reload keeps the commit list: after adding "feat: add login" and reloading, the list still shows "feat: add login" and the button "Generate changelog" is present.
